mastery_cards_numeric_bounds_check.name: mastery_cards_numeric_bounds_check
mastery_cards_numeric_bounds_check.value: "mastery_cards"."stability" >= 0 AND "mastery_cards"."difficulty" >= 0 AND "mastery_cards"."difficulty" <= 10 AND "mastery_cards"."elapsed_days" >= 0 AND "mastery_cards"."scheduled_days" >= 0 AND "mastery_cards"."reps" >= 0 AND "mastery_cards"."lapses" >= 0 AND "mastery_cards"."revision" >= 0 AND "mastery_cards"."state" IN ('new', 'learning', 'review', 'relearning')

mastery_evidence_bounds_check.name: mastery_evidence_bounds_check
mastery_evidence_bounds_check.value: "mastery_evidence"."evidence_ordinal" >= 0 AND "mastery_evidence"."retention_strength" >= 0 AND "mastery_evidence"."retention_strength" <= 1 AND "mastery_evidence"."practice_coverage" >= 0 AND "mastery_evidence"."practice_coverage" <= 1 AND "mastery_evidence"."evidence_confidence" >= 0 AND "mastery_evidence"."evidence_confidence" <= 1 AND "mastery_evidence"."attempt_count" >= 0

mastery_states_bounds_check.name: mastery_states_bounds_check
mastery_states_bounds_check.value: "mastery_states"."mastery_level" >= 0 AND "mastery_states"."mastery_level" <= 1 AND "mastery_states"."live_retention" >= 0 AND "mastery_states"."live_retention" <= 1 AND "mastery_states"."evidence_confidence" >= 0 AND "mastery_states"."evidence_confidence" <= 1 AND "mastery_states"."revision" >= 0 AND "mastery_states"."mastery_state" IN ('unseen', 'introduced', 'practicing', 'proficient', 'mastered')

activity_session_events_assessment_check.name: activity_session_events_assessment_check
activity_session_events_assessment_check.value: ("activity_session_events"."is_assessed" = false AND "activity_session_events"."submission_id" IS NULL AND "activity_session_events"."submission_json" IS NULL) OR ("activity_session_events"."is_assessed" = true AND "activity_session_events"."submission_id" IS NOT NULL AND "activity_session_events"."submission_json" IS NOT NULL)

activity_session_events_projection_check.name: activity_session_events_projection_check
activity_session_events_projection_check.value: ("activity_session_events"."is_assessed" = false AND "activity_session_events"."mastery_projection_status" IS NULL) OR ("activity_session_events"."is_assessed" = true AND "activity_session_events"."mastery_projection_status" IN ('pending', 'projected', 'failed'))

activity_sessions_tenant_check.name: activity_sessions_tenant_check
activity_sessions_tenant_check.value: ("activity_sessions"."school_id" IS NOT NULL AND "activity_sessions"."tenant_key" = "activity_sessions"."school_id"::text) OR ("activity_sessions"."school_id" IS NULL AND length("activity_sessions"."tenant_key") > 0)

capability_idempotency_owner_state_check.name: capability_idempotency_owner_state_check
capability_idempotency_owner_state_check.value: ("capability_idempotency_records"."state" = 'owned' AND "capability_idempotency_records"."ownership_token" IS NOT NULL AND "capability_idempotency_records"."output_json" IS NULL AND "capability_idempotency_records"."error_json" IS NULL) OR ("capability_idempotency_records"."state" = 'completed' AND "capability_idempotency_records"."ownership_token" IS NULL AND "capability_idempotency_records"."output_json" IS NOT NULL AND "capability_idempotency_records"."error_json" IS NULL) OR ("capability_idempotency_records"."state" IN ('retryable', 'terminal') AND "capability_idempotency_records"."ownership_token" IS NULL AND "capability_idempotency_records"."output_json" IS NULL AND "capability_idempotency_records"."error_json" IS NOT NULL)

standard_pack_successor_commitments_dige.name: standard_pack_successor_commitments_digest_format_check
standard_pack_successor_commitments_dige.value: "standard_pack_successor_commitments"."predecessor_index_digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "standard_pack_successor_commitments"."predecessor_catalog_digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "standard_pack_successor_commitments"."predecessor_source_receipt_digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "standard_pack_successor_commitments"."successor_batch_digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "standard_pack_successor_commitments"."successor_catalog_digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "standard_pack_successor_commitments"."successor_source_receipt_digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "standard_pack_successor_commitments"."candidate_tree_digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "standard_pack_successor_commitments"."descriptor_digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "standard_pack_successor_commitments"."source_packet_digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "standard_pack_successor_commitments"."candidate_digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "standard_pack_successor_commitments"."commitment_digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
